bookwriter.notice.title: Book Writer
bookwriter.replace.tooltip: Replace this book with clipboard text. Confirmation required.
bookwriter.append.tooltip: Add clipboard text on new pages, preserving existing text.
bookwriter.undo.tooltip: Restore the book to before the last import in this editing session.
bookwriter.confirm.title: Import clipboard text?
bookwriter.confirm.replace: Replace all %s existing page(s) with %s imported page(s)? You can undo while this book editor remains open. Click Done to save afterward.
bookwriter.confirm.append: Append %s page(s), for %s total? Existing text stays unchanged. Click Done to save afterward.
bookwriter.confirm.undo: Restore the book to before the last import? This also discards any manual edits made since that import.
bookwriter.empty: Book Writer: the clipboard contains no text to import.
bookwriter.too_large: Book Writer: the clipboard exceeds the %s-character safety limit. Nothing was changed.
bookwriter.cannot_paginate: Book Writer: this text could not be fitted to the current font. Nothing was changed.
bookwriter.overflow: Book Writer: this text does not fit in the %s available page(s). Nothing was changed. Shorten the text or split it between books.
bookwriter.imported: Book Writer: imported %s page(s), %s total. Click Done to save, or Undo to restore the previous text.
bookwriter.restored: Book Writer: previous pages restored. Click Done to save.
